mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) at or below 0.1% is always associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to compressed discount rates and accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month CPI increase exceeding 0.5% signals inflationary pressure that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL month-over-month change exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP (GDPC1) exceeds 20000 billion and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is at or below 0.1%, strong economic growth and accommodative policy drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction condition (GDPC1 > 20000 and FEDFUNDS <= 0.1) is met in more than 50% of instances but SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: In the high unemployment recovery phase (UNRATE > 5.5%), market anticipation of labor market recovery drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 5.5.

mechanism_narrative: The industrial production index (INDPRO) is always associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as a decline signals potential economic recovery and increased equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO is reported.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1550 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market and broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances where HOUST < 1550.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) fall below 142500 thousand and real personal consumption (RSAFS) falls below 540000 million, dual weakness in labor and consumption markets drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: dual weakness in labor and consumption
failure_condition: The interaction condition (PAYEMS < 142500 and RSAFS < 540000) is met in more than 50% of instances but SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: In the strong economic growth regime (GDPC1 > 20000 billion), robust corporate earnings and investor confidence drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 > 20000.
